## Design note

Big V8 noise and big straight-line pace for the money. It is traction-limited off the line and in 2nd, so throttle discipline is the skill; once hooked up it out-drags everything except the exotic. Heavy nose means it pushes when rushed into a corner, then snaps loose if you stab the throttle to fix it.

## How this car breaks

Modern crash structure: UHSS cabin, long crumple rails, so it absorbs a hard frontal and the cabin stays intact even in Simulation at moderate speed. That safety costs the front clip — the big cooling pack and low splitter are toast after any nose hit. Wide doors dent easily.

## Sources (type)

- manufacturer spec-class data for 2010s 5.0 V8 muscle coupes
- owner dyno averages for modern NA 5.0 DOHC V8s
- engineering tables (tire radius, ride frequency, multi-piston caliper hydraulics)

All values are class-typical figures for the archetype, rounded; no single real vehicle is reproduced.

## Inertia

Box approximation about the CG, scaled for mass concentration (`k < 1`: mass near the centre, e.g. mid-engine; `k → 1`: mass at the ends):

```
I_roll  = k_r · m·(W² + H²)/12
I_pitch = k_p · m·(L² + H²)/12
I_yaw   = k_y · m·(W² + L²)/12
```

| Axis | Box (kg·m²) | k | `inertia_kgm2` |
|---|---|---|---|
| roll | 827 | 0.80 | 660 |
| pitch | 3661 | 0.90 | 3300 |
| yaw | 3925 | 0.92 | 3610 |

## Engine

5.0 L DOHC 32-valve V8, naturally aspirated. Class-typical 2010s NA 5.0 V8 (~64 kW/L) with the broad, flat torque curve owner dynos show for modern DOHC V8s.

Peak **319 kW @ 6750 rpm**, **529 N·m @ 4250 rpm**. Idle 700 / redline 7000 / limiter 7400 rpm. Rotating inertia 0.22 kg·m² (class: 0.10 small four … 0.30 big-block). Engine braking 10% of peak torque = 53 N·m. Power-to-weight 180 kW/t.

## Drivetrain

6-speed manual, helical-gear-style rear LSD (modelled as clutch LSD). Layout **RWD**; front diff: open; rear diff: clutch LSD, preload 50 N·m, power ramp 0.50, coast ramp 0.35. Clutch capacity 1.35 × peak torque = 710 N·m. Shift time 0.25 s.

| Gear | Ratio | Overall | km/h @ redline |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 3.66 | 12.99 | 69 |
| 2 | 2.43 | 8.63 | 104 |
| 3 | 1.69 | 6.00 | 150 |
| 4 | 1.32 | 4.69 | 192 |
| 5 | 1.00 | 3.55 | 253 |
| 6 | 0.65 | 2.31 | 390 |

Final drive 3.55, reverse 3.53. Speeds use the driven-wheel loaded radius 0.341 m.

## Suspension

Springs from ride frequency, `k = m_s·(2πf)²` with sprung corner mass `m_s = axle load/2 − unsprung`; dampers `c = 2ζ·√(k·m_s)`, ζ = 0.30 bump, rebound = 1.5 × bump.

| Axle | m_s | f | Wheel rate k | Bump c | Rebound c | Travel |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Front | 453 kg | 1.55 Hz | 43000 N/m | 2650 N·s/m | 3980 N·s/m | 0.16 m |
| Rear | 380 kg | 1.65 Hz | 40900 N/m | 2370 N·s/m | 3560 N·s/m | 0.17 m |

Anti-roll bars from a roll-gradient target of 2.8°/g with 60% of roll stiffness at the front. Roll arm h − h_rc = 0.402 m (roll centres 0.08 m F / 0.12 m R). Required total K_φ = m·g·arm/φ = 143095 N·m/rad; springs give k·t²/2 = 53659 F / 55633 R N·m/rad; bars supply the rest as `arb_n_per_m = K_bar/t²` = **12900 F / 600 R N/m** (clamped at ≥ 0). Resulting gradient 2.8°/g, front share 60%. Bump stops 170000 N/m.

Alignment: camber -0.8° F / -1.0° R, toe +0.00° F / +0.20° R (+ = in), caster 7.0°.

## Brakes

Full-pedal line pressure 100 bar.

- Front: 380 mm disc, pistons per side 46 mm + 40 mm + 36 mm → A = 39.4 cm², r_eff = D/2 − 25 mm = 165 mm, pad μ = 0.42: T = 2·μ·p·A·r_eff = 2·0.42·100 bar·39.4 cm²·0.165 m = **5456 N·m**
- Rear: 330 mm disc, pistons per side 45 mm → A = 15.9 cm², r_eff = D/2 − 25 mm = 140 mm, pad μ = 0.4: T = 2·μ·p·A·r_eff = 2·0.4·100 bar·15.9 cm²·0.140 m = **1781 N·m**

Lock check at 1 g on μ = 1 (load transfer m·a·h/L): front needs 2099 N·m/wheel (capacity 2.60×), rear needs 819 N·m/wheel (capacity 2.17×). `bias_front` = f + 0.9·h/L = 0.71 (ideal distribution at 0.9 g, clamped 0.55-0.78). Handbrake 1430 N·m per rear wheel.

## Steering

Ratio 15.7:1. Kerb-to-kerb turning circle 11.6 m → outer-front path radius 5.67 m, rear-axle-centre radius 4.19 m → mean road-wheel lock δ = atan(L/R) = **0.576 rad (33.0°)** (outer 28.7°, inner 38.7° at full Ackermann; `ackermann_frac` 0.60). Rack speed 1.4 rad/s.

## Damage lattice (`data/lattices/rampart_50.json`)

120 nodes, 704 beams, 3 detachables, 21 component mounts.

- Generated with `gen-box-lattice --id rampart_50 --width 1.92 --length 4.78 --height 1.38 --wheelbase 2.72 --mass 390.5 --clearance 0.13` (22% of vehicle mass).
- Shaped top layer to the `coupe` profile (hood/deck/bumper tops dropped to beltline, greenhouse narrowed to 86% width).
- Beams: pillars + roof rails → hss 7.0e-04 m² (34 beams).
- Beams: cabin cell → hss 6.5e-04 m² (88 beams).
- Beams: sills → hss 6.0e-04 m² (6 beams).
- Beams: crumple (outer) rail segments → hss 2.0e-04 m² (36 beams).
- Beams: inner rail segments / firewall → hss 5.0e-04 m² (36 beams).
- Beams: hood → aluminum 1.5e-4 m² (16 beams).
- Beams: outer panels → mild_steel 1.5e-04 m² (284 beams).
- Components: radiator at row 8 ahead of the engine (fails first), longitudinal engine at row 7, gearbox in the tunnel, prop shaft to the rear axle, fuel tank ahead of the rear axle.
- Detachables: FrontBumper 3000 N·s / 6 kg, RearBumper 3000 N·s / 6 kg, Hood 3500 N·s / 9 kg.
- Node mass: engine-mount nodes ×2.5, renormalised to 390 kg total.
